name: Cage-Building Algorithm
definition: An automated pipeline to generate a simple, tight, and artifact-free deformation cage enclosing a 3DGS scene by converting the scene to depth maps, reconstructing a solid voxel grid, and simplifying it with a two-stage decimation process that enforces non-negative Mean Value Coordinates (MVCs).
summary: The Cage-Building Algorithm generates a tight deformation cage for 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes by converting depth maps into a voxel grid and simplifying it with a two-stage decimation process that enforces non-negative Mean Value Coordinates.
